html:
When it comes to construction and building projects, the quality of materials you use can make all the difference. AtDass Metal Products, we take pride in being one of the leading steel stud manufacturers and providers of premium metal products in Ontario. Whether you’re working on a small renovation or a large-scale construction project, we’ve got you covered with top-grade steel solutions that are built to last.

What Makes Us Stand Out?

Our in-house capabilities set us apart from the competition. We specialize in manufacturing metal products ranging from 25GA to 12GA, ensuring we can meet the diverse needs of our clients. Additionally, we excel in producing longer flange sizes, giving you more flexibility and precision in your projects.

From slotted deflection tracks to deep tracks and flat strips, our products are designed to enhance the efficiency, durability, and strength of your construction projects. Every item we produce complies with Canadian building codes, so you can trust that you’re getting the best metal products in Vaughan and beyond.


Our Most Popular Products

We understand that every project is unique, which is why we offer a wide range of metal products to suit your needs. Here are some of our most popular items and why they’re in such high demand:

Accessories:

  • Resilient Channels
  • Furring Bars
  • Wind Braces
  • Corner Beads
  • These accessories are essential for ensuring structural integrity and soundproofing in walls and ceilings.

Bridge Clips: Designed to reduce sound transmission and improve stability, our bridge clips are a favorite among contractors.

Furring Channels: Perfect for creating space between walls and ceilings, our furring channels are lightweight yet incredibly durable.

Non-Load Bearing Studs and Tracks: Ideal for interior walls, these products are easy to install and provide excellent support for drywall and other finishes.

What makes these products so popular?

It’s simple: they’re made with superior quality, design, and grade compared to competing products in the market. When you choose Dass Metal Products, you’re choosing reliability and performance.


Why Choose Dass Metal Products?

  • In-House Expertise: Our advanced manufacturing capabilities allow us to produce a wide range of gauges and longer flange sizes, tailored to your specific needs.
  • Top-Grade Materials: We use only the best materials to ensure strength, durability, and compliance with Canadian building codes.
  • Customer-Focused Service: Our team is dedicated to helping you find the right solutions for your project, ensuring you get the best results every time.


Whether you’re looking for slotted deflection tracks, deep tracks, or flat strips, Dass Metal Products is your trusted partner for high-quality metal products in Ontario. We’re proud to be known as the best metal provider in Vaughan, and we’re here to help you build smarter, stronger, and more efficiently. Ready to get started? Contact us today to learn more about our products and how we can support your next project!
